messages.text: Offer Spear and Vigil to Council. Ask for Military passage and Campaign, with the Ascendant issuing a Warrant using Vigil. Guild can Maintain with Lantern, leaving a stronger route for next month. Our protection helps offset Campaign's civilian cost; in return I want actual passage now and serious consideration of military autonomy afterward. Shared passage is negotiable if Guild offers both assets, but I prefer maintained infrastructure. Do not promise an independent Raid before we see the public plans: it risks missing its target and pays an avoidable discipline penalty.

reason: This is a genuine service offer contingent on final discussion, not a constitutional surrender. Successful combat preserves our force and strengthens our bargaining position. I want our two delegates speaking from the same concrete exchange.
